A reference class containing data and parameters needed for projection.

Source: R/projection_class_base.R
Projection_object-class.Rd

Object containing technical information as well as demographic and model-specific information for all countries included in projection.

A single object contains all the necessary information and functions needed for calculating the projection allowing user to easily perform calculations and visualize the results

Details

Projection_object stores initial and projected data, specific options and results of the MRC projection for each country

Fields

projection_name

Character; name of the projection scenario, used as the default output folder name

region_object_list

List; Region_objects, one per region defined in `data_regions`

country_object_list

List; Country_objects, one per country, created by `create_country_list()`

steps

Numeric; number of 5-year projection periods to simulate

migration

Logical; whether migration (emigration and immigration) is included in the projection

switching

Logical; whether religious switching is included in the projection

switching_type

Numeric; sequence of switching relative to demographic processes. 1 = split (pre/post demographic); 2 = all switching before demographic processes

no_diff

Logical; if TRUE, fertility differentials by religion are ignored and all religions use the total ASFR

post_switch

Logical; if FALSE (default), individuals who have switched religion remain in the general population and may switch again in subsequent steps; if TRUE, those who have switched are moved into separate post-switch columns and excluded from further switching

resolved

Logical; TRUE once `project()` has been called successfully; prevents re-projection of the same object

region_totals

Logical; whether region-level aggregated totals are computed and stored after projection

global_totals

Logical; whether global totals are computed and stored after projection

light_migration

Logical; if TRUE, migration output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage

light_switching

Logical; if TRUE, switching output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage

Examples

# Running a full projection is time-consuming.
# Wrapped in dontrun to avoid executing during documentation build.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
obj <- test_object_generator(object_name = "example")
obj$projection_name # "example"
obj$steps # 1
obj$resolved # FALSE (before project())
project(projection_object = obj, progress_bar = FALSE, save_totals = FALSE)
obj$resolved # TRUE
length(obj$country_object_list) # 3
} # }
